answer:
Implemented and compiled successfully (CODESYS 3.5 ST, 0 errors, 0 warnings).

FB_Task interface preserved exactly: inputs Demand, FaultA, FaultB; outputs PumpA, PumpB, LeadA (init TRUE). Retained state: prevDemand, episodeServed; helper vars runA/runB/completedServed.

Logic:
- runA := Demand AND NOT FaultA AND (LeadA OR FaultB)
- runB := Demand AND NOT FaultB AND (NOT LeadA OR FaultA)
  → faulted pumps never run, both-off when no demand, mutual exclusion (no simultaneous run), healthy lead preferred with immediate fallback on fault (fault changes take effect within the same scan/episode).
- completedServed := prevDemand AND NOT Demand AND episodeServed → toggles LeadA exactly once on the falling edge of a served continuous demand episode; an all-faulted episode with no running scan leaves LeadA unchanged (P6/P7). LeadA is never overwritten during demand, so it stays the retained preference rather than a report of the present fallback pump.
- prevDemand updated at end of scan; episodeServed set whenever a pump actually ran during the episode and cleared when Demand is FALSE.

All fixed traces of the "alternate" and "fallback" tests are satisfied by construction (initial scan, held demand, served/unserved falling edges, fault fallback, recovery, and a final served episode that toggles the lead). Note: only compiler verification was performed; no PLC functional tests were executed.
